what: an R1.5 fillet of the 32 vertical root edges of 8 ribs between two walls of a grille tray (a performance case: the time must not blow up)
method: tray: plate 100x60x3, two walls 100x4 up to z=12 (so 9 above the plate), 8 ribs 1.2 thick x 52 long x 9 tall between the walls: V0 = 18000 + 2*100*4*9 + 8*1.2*52*9 = 29692.8. The 4N = 64 vertical concave edges where a rib side meets a wall (length 9) are rounded R1.5, each adding (1-pi/4) r^2 x 9; ribs are 5.6 apart, gaps 4.4 > 2 r, so the rounds never meet. V = V0 + 32 (1-pi/4) 2.25 * 9 = 29831.862.
